intro: We back artists, designers, filmmakers, and writers who make the hidden systems shaping our lives visible—and imagine how they could work differently.
copy: The modern internet promised connection, but many platforms now turn creative labour into raw material

—scraped, consumed, and resold without consent. This is not a rejection of technology. It is a refusal to treat its direction as predetermined. Creatives should have a say in the systems being built around them.

Supported by a founding grant from Spiral and private patrons, we bring creative practice into conversations about open money, open intelligence, and the systems shaping culture, technology, and everyday life.
